summary: Data analytics professional pursuing a Master's in Data Analytics at Northeastern University, with hands-on forecasting experience through independent projects and applied research. Skilled in building automated forecasting pipelines using Prophet and AWS, turning data into actionable insights, and communicating findings to non-technical audiences. Strong Excel analytics background from automating workflows and analyzing transit data.

experience.title: Data Analytics Intern - Northeastern/City of Toronto Research Partnership
bullets: Analyzed public-transit vs. highway usage by originating region (Durham, Halton, Peel, York) across three years to identify where transit adoption lagged, directly informing where the city could target public-transit awareness campaigns.

Contributed to a research team partnered with the City of Toronto's Transportation Services to analyze mobility patterns (TELUS Insights, 100K+ devices) for major recurring events such as Pride Parade and Caribbean Carnival. Findings were presented to the city's traffic management office and referenced in Northeastern's public research coverage.

experience.title: Global Risk Intelligence and Technology Co-op
bullets: Automated Excel-based workflows using Python (Pandas, OpenPyXL) across 56 files, saving 170-220 hours per week and eliminating repetitive manual effort.

Recommended a prioritization framework for 80+ candidate automation use cases, ranking by effort-to-impact ratio, and designed a reusable AI agent capability architecture, cutting solution complexity by 75% across 20 capabilities.
Authored technical documentation and handover guides to reduce onboarding friction for future contributors.

projects.title: Toronto Island Ferry Sales Forecasting
bullets: Built an automated forecasting pipeline using Prophet, Apache Airflow, and DVC to generate demand forecasts for Toronto Island Ferry services.
Deployed a containerized application on AWS ECS/ECR with CI/CD and designed a Streamlit dashboard to visualize forecasted demand trends.

projects.title: Bank Transaction Fraud Detection - End-to-End ML Pipeline
bullets: Developed a fraud classification pipeline (1M synthetic transactions, 17:1 class imbalance) using XGBoost with a 3-tier flagging system that achieved 28.5% fraud capture at an 11% flag rate.
Used SHAP to identify top fraud drivers and built a multi-page Power BI dashboard with KPI cards, tier-based slicers, and feature-importance views for risk-management style review.
